description: Composite geodesic (Bohra & Sivaramakrishnan arXiv:2511.22168) test for HYP-2026-006 holographic transport factor-of-2 discrepancy

spacelike_geodesic.formula: T_spacelike = pi * R  (global AdS3 antipodal crossing time)

composite_geodesic.formula: T_composite = pi*R/2  (null geodesic condition: transport at T = lightcone crossing)
composite_geodesic.derivation: Transport occurs when geodesic P1(t=0)->P2(t=T) becomes null: -<P1,P2>=1 => cos(T)+1=1 => T=pi/2

verdict.mechanism: Holographic transport time = null geodesic condition T = pi/2 * l_AdS, exactly half the spacelike crossing time pi*l_AdS. Composite geodesic (B&S 2025) provides the geometric interpretation: spacelike+timelike composite path, with transport triggered at the lightcone crossing.
verdict.next_step: Match normalization convention for l_AdS vs xi to unify SIM-2026-002 fit with analytical MERA value. Then test on larger system (24q) to verify pi/2 scaling.
